## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5); mixed mega-cap trends and weak overall sector breadth confirm a neutral market backdrop.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology leads: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing modest strength: PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND. Materials modestly positive on 1W gains but no dominant SP100 leaders this week.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +1.52%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +2.12%) CORRECTION, VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) CORRECTION. Utilities weak: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate showing weakness: CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) CORRECTION, CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communication, Tech software and select cyclical names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR divergence across several names (multiple SP100 names with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend breaks and short-lived rotations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech mixed but leader: AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.53% | 1M: +3.99%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND; pockets of software weakness: ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W positive but leadership narrow.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials weak overall (1W -1.08%): JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY — no broad bank-led risk-on; financials showing distribution.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare modestly positive: JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY — watch MRK headlines (mixed bullish and bearish) creating idiosyncratic risk within the sector.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective Technology exposure given strong QCOM/INTC/META/AMD moves but keep positions tactical due to narrow leadership and weak overall breadth; reduce exposure to lagging Communication and select Energy/Real Estate holdings. Monitor RECOVERY names (SHOP, AMGN, MA) for either trend confirmation or failure before increasing exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.08%) and Healthcare (1W: +1.60%) for continuation or profit-taking.  
BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.68%) and Utilities (1W: -2.70%) for further weakness or reversal.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch for loss of weekly momentum in QCOM/INTC/META (weekly reversal would signal leadership rollback). Monitor AAPL holding its 1M uptrend to keep ABOVE TREND status. For Financials, JPM reclaiming sustained weekly gains would be needed to shift sector bias from BELOW TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
QCOM (+55): Qualcomm renews patent license with AAPL; price confirming as QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment aligned. PLTR (+50): Palantir expands AI deals; PLTR (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. AMD (+50): BofA target lift; AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirms momentum.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
CCI (-55): Dividend cut headline; CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. VLO (-50): diesel/export risk; VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines coincide with 1W weakness (trend exhaustion). INTU (noted market weakness) aligns with INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm stress.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given concentrated Tech leadership. QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership and multiple RECOVERY/CORRECTION divergences (SHOP, AMGN, VLO) alongside mixed news flows warrant tactical positioning and close monitoring.
